name: mypc-input
description: Wireless phone-to-PC text input and clipboard sync
author: Aklas

scripts.build:native: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run build; Compress-Archive -Path dist\* -DestinationPath dist.zip -Force; C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /nologo /target:winexe /win32icon:app.ico /resource:dist.zip,dist.zip /resource:lib\QRCoder.dll,QRCoder.dll /optimize+ /r:System.dll,System.Windows.Forms.dll,System.Drawing.dll,System.IO.Compression.dll,System.IO.Compression.FileSystem.dll,lib\QRCoder.dll /out:MyPc-Input.exe native\*.cs; Remove-Item dist.zip -Force"
